reactive_music.title: Reactive Music
reactive_music.config.category.debug.too: Tools for songpack authors and developers
reactive_music.config.songpack.failed.de:
This songpack could not be loaded:

%s
reactive_music.config.option.music_delay:
How much silence there is between two songs.

SONGPACK_DEFAULT uses the value recommended by the songpack author.
reactive_music.config.option.music_switc:
How long to wait before fading out when the current situation no longer matches.

SONGPACK_DEFAULT uses the value recommended by the songpack author.
reactive_music.config.option.custom_dela: Overrides the delay above. -1 keeps using the preset / songpack value.
reactive_music.config.option.custom_swit: Overrides the switch speed above. -1 keeps using the preset / songpack value.
reactive_music.config.option.fade_out.de: How long a song takes to fade out completely.
reactive_music.config.option.paused_volu: Music is turned down to this percentage while the game is paused or a menu is open.
reactive_music.config.option.debug_mode_:
Enables songpack developer features:
- switches songs instantly when the situation changes
- always shows all songpack loading errors in this menu
